resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1965 is the year of the current cab and tower. The site was a lookout by 1920, so the record's build year describes the present structure, not the first lookout.
Older towers were 35 feet (1939 newspaper) and 50 feet (1961 survey note); the 1965 tower is given as 42 feet. The record's 13.0 m is close to 42 feet (12.8 m) but not the same figure.

sources.title: Smoke, Signals, and Seedlings: A Visit to Hayfork Bally

notes_for_editor: Record height_m 13.0 vs NHLR 42-foot tower (12.8 m); 1939 and 1961 sources describe earlier towers of 35 and 50 feet, so the height figure depends on which structure is meant. Record 'built 1965' is the current structure, not the first lookout (since at least 1920). Access not documented; 'restricted' reflects an active fire station with radio equipment. Trinity Journal 2018 staffing article was rate-limited (HTTP 429) and not read. No photos proposed.
